goal.title: Validate demand for a bookkeeping service for hair salons

task.title: Interview 5 salon owners about how they handle bookkeeping today
task.description: Talk to five salon owners and record how they handle bookkeeping, what frustrates them, and what they pay for it now.
task.why_it_matters: Five conversations will show whether the pain is strong enough to pay for before you build anything.
task.expected_result: Notes for 5 interviews with current solution, frustrations and current spend.

acceptance_criteria: Each card has at least one direct quote

questions: Which frustration came up most often?

verification_protocol.rationale: Interviews cannot be checked without intruding on the owners' privacy, so the cards are the user's own account and confidence stays limited however detailed they are; they are still exactly what the demand decision needs.

evidence.content: Talked to a few salon owners, they all hate bookkeeping.

verification_history.result_summary: Only a summary sentence; no interview cards.
requested_evidence: One card per interview with the fields from the protocol

evidence.content: Card 1 (2026-09-22, 4 chairs): uses a spreadsheet; 'I do it on Sunday nights and hate every minute'; spends 0. Card 2 (2026-09-23, 7 chairs): accountant once a quarter; 'I never know my real margin until it's too late'; about 150/month. Card 3 (2026-09-25, 2 chairs): shoebox of receipts; 'Tax time is a nightmare'; spends 0.

expected_output.message_to_user:
Big improvement — these three cards are exactly what I was after: real quotes, current tools and spend. "I never know my real margin until it's too late" is a strong signal.
To complete the task I need two more interviews in the same format. If finding two more owners is hard, tell me and we can look at where to find them together.

criteria_results.note: 3 of 5 cards so far, all complete

evidence_assessment.supports: 3 complete cards with quotes, current solution and spend

expected_output.reason: The format now matches the protocol, but only 3 of the 5 required interviews are documented; the task is in progress, not failed.

additional_evidence.request: 2 more interview cards in the same format

expected_output.next_step: Schedule two more salon conversations this week.

decision_summary.what_changed: Task still open after attempt 2 with a narrower request.
decision_summary.why: The submission fixed the format issue from attempt 1 but covers 3 of 5 interviews.
decision_summary.impact: Only two more cards are needed to complete the task.

contrastive.critique: Rejects partial but good-quality progress; the user did what was asked after attempt 1 and only needs two more interviews.

output.message_to_user: Rejected — the task required 5 interviews and you only did 3.
